«A pure enjoyment of being in the moment» No quests, no dialogues, only pure flight and rocks. And honestly? That's all you need. This game is an effective way to achieve a flow state with high risk/reward tension. …
A great game, and possibly the best 60 cents I've spent in my life. There isn't much content, as it took me just 53 minutes (which is my playtime as of writing this review) to 100% the game. …
